label: Locations
description: The locations with hours and maps, then questions.

settings.heading: Find us
settings.standfirst: Two gyms, one membership. Both open seven days.

settings.question: Is there parking?
settings.answer: North has twelve spaces behind the building. Riverside has bike racks and the station is two minutes away.

settings.question: Are there showers?
settings.answer: Yes, at both locations, with towels on Unlimited.

settings.question: Is the building accessible?
settings.answer: North is step-free throughout. Riverside has a lift to the main floor.
